visible_setting: A completely dry apartment corridor seen entirely from outside a fully closed front door. Deeper behind the woman, elevator doors are halfway through closing and the call button still glows; there is no interior view.
observable_action: The man keeps his hips and shoes aimed toward the elevator but twists his upper body back to pull the single exterior handle with his right hand. The woman is caught mid-pivot from the elevator: her left foot remains pointed at it, her lifted right heel steps back toward the apartment, three tiny fading graphite motion ticks curve from the elevator threshold to that heel, and her right palm presses the closed door panel beside the latch.
hands_and_contact: Only two focal hands are visible: his right hand owns the exterior handle and her right palm owns the separate door-panel contact. Their left hands are naturally hidden. Neither person touches the other, and their torsos do not overlap.
gaze: Both look toward the closed-door test with small knowing smiles rather than looking at the viewer.
body_blocking: At least one forearm of empty space separates their torsos. Both lower bodies still point outward toward the closing elevator, while only their upper bodies and action arms turn back to the closed apartment door.
object_state: The front door is fully closed; its handle is being pulled while the panel beside the latch is pressed. The soft tote hangs from her left shoulder and a tightly rolled unused umbrella rests under her left arm. No key or key fob is visible. Clothes, hair, shoes, umbrella, and corridor floor are pristine and dry.
camera_view: A medium-wide, nearly straight-on exterior corridor view keeps the closed door plane, two separated full-body figures, two distinct action arms, halfway-closing elevator, glowing call button, and physical heel-pivot trail readable at once.
visible_continuity: Pristine date-night clothes, the same soft tote, the tightly rolled unused umbrella, outward-pointing feet, and the still-closing elevator establish an interrupted departure before rain; there are no rain marks, damp fabric, tired posture, food traces, visible keys, arrows, ghost bodies, or post-outing wear.
